title: Cross Country Trail Rides
specs: 300 mile trail system over private, state, and federal lands
Scenic views including hills, bluffs, and rivers
Health papers and Coggins test required for out of state animals; Missouri residents need Coggins only
All guests must use dehydrated pelleted bedding in stalls; bedding available onsite for $5 per 40# bag
Driver must be 18 or older with valid license to operate golf carts or UTVs inside camp
Approximately 600 guests attend Late Fall event; events accommodate families and serious trail riders
includes: Camping with electric and water hookup
blurb: Guests ride horses on a 300 mile trail system covering private, state, and federal lands. Events include organized trail rides, meals, camping with hookups, nightly dances, and other activities. Stalls and campsites are available with required deposits and fees.
extraNote: Deposit required: $30 per stall, $10 per campsite, $50 reservation fee · Reservations may be canceled by phone, mail or email before deadline for refund or transfer · No refunds or credits for inclement weather or acts of God · Guests charged from arrival date through end of event; no refunds for early departure; late arrivals charged pro-rated rate
